ycy tunnel server
Run the Tunnel Control Plane and supervised frps process
Usage:
  ycy tunnel server [flags]
Flags:
  --address	Address for all tunnel server listeners
  --advertise-frp-addr	FRP endpoint advertised to trusted clients
  --control-port	Tunnel Control Plane port
  --data-dir	Tunnel server state directory
  --frp-port	FRP bind port
  -h, --help	help for server
  --http-port	FRP HTTP vhost port
  --port-range	Server Port Pool
  --session-idle-days	Session idle lifetime in days
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
